integration.rto: MI providers may be reconstructed at a state point
integration.intentions: dynamic management/negotiation consumer; no semantic changes in this package
integration.placement: jobs are placed into memory/storage execution contexts; Job-to-Node remains lease authority
integration.multiProviderMemory: logical requests may span explicit provider fragments; no transparent remote-pointer claim
integration.snapshotSemantics: parallel scan/computation/materialisation use immutable collection-membership epochs; application object internals are not deep-frozen
integration.memoryBlockBag: MU-resident page-aligned external memory container; native mapping/copy connector, QEMU/DMA implementation below ABI
integration.providerLifecycle: ACTIVE/SPARE/DRAINING/OFFLINE transitions are generation-controlled; reincarnation advances membership epoch and fences prior blocks
integration.miBlockAttachment: MI attachment leases bind an MI epoch to one MU bag incarnation; payload movement stays below the Rexx object/API boundary
integration.rexxosPaging: MI page groups retain ownership/dirty/pin/backing state; prepare/commit transfer plans fence MI and MU epochs while payload movement remains native QEMU/shared-memory/DMA
